main_visual_task: The silent coffee mission reaches its largest risk: the full cup nearly touches the bedside table, is lowered without a click, then the apparently sleeping woman stops the retreating hand and reveals she was awake; finish on coffee as the final memory.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same established young Chinese woman around twenty-eight, dark shoulder-length hair, natural East Asian features, cream cotton sleep top; the same man's realistic five-fingered hands and light-blue rolled sleeves; one unlabeled white ceramic cup filled with real dark coffee
prompt_bible.environment_lock: the same quiet modern Chinese bedroom, white bedding, light wooden bedside table, sheer curtains and rain-fresh window, no other people
prompt_bible.material_lock: real skin pores, cotton weave, ceramic glaze, dark coffee, subtle crema and physically plausible steam; accurate fingers and hand contact
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: the same one real sunrise source from upper left and cool ambient fill; every shadow falls lower right
prompt_bible.palette_lock: morning gold, cream white, pale blue, warm wood and espresso brown
prompt_bible.lens_texture: live-action 35mm cinema camera, shallow depth of field, natural film grain, restrained movement and true skin texture
prompt_bible.screen_direction: cup travels left to right toward the bedside table; woman stays frame right; hands withdraw right before she stops one
prompt_bible.audio_policy: no dialogue; one deeper breath, amplified almost-contact, cloth compression, release into room tone and a final music chord added in post
